headline: The TJX Companies (TJX) Looks Attractive on Market Share Gains and Margin Expansion
summary: Jensen Investment Management, an asset management company based in the US, released its second-quarter 2026 investor letter for the ” Jensen Quality Growth Equity Strategy”.
